input.prompt:
WAN 2.6 REFERENCE-TO-VIDEO — PRODUCTION UNIT 014 (01:08–01:12)

SOURCE AUTHORITY:
Recreate the opening KTV scene from anime/screenshotwithdesc/complete-script.md. Preserve the exact quoted dialogue below; inherited source-document timestamps are intentionally ignored. Do not invent, paraphrase or add story events.

REFERENCE MAP:
The supplied first frame is the shot-specific staging frame for this unit. Preserve its composition, camera height, lens feel, character identities, wardrobe, seating, props and lighting at 0.0s.
Image 1 is the final rendered frame of generation unit 013. Use it only as an editorial continuity guide for identity, wardrobe, seating geography, eyelines, lighting and set state. This unit begins after an intentional hard cut to its supplied staging angle; never morph from Image 1 into the new angle.
Image 2 is the KTV setting and continuity sheet. Image 3 is the principal speaker identity reference when present.

OUTPUT:
Create one continuous 4-second silent cinematic 2D anime shot, 16:9 at 720P. Use restrained realistic acting, stable faces and hands, natural breathing and blinks, and subtle hair/fabric motion. No internal cut, montage, audio, subtitles or text. Keep at least 0.5 seconds stable at both ends for evaluation and editing.

COMPOSITION AND BLOCKING:
Tight reaction close-up on 柳如烟.
Maintain the established 180-degree axis, left/right seating geography, matching eyelines, wardrobe, warm amber/cool blue lighting, furniture and empty coffee-table state. The table contains no alcohol, bottles, glasses or drinks. Angle changes happen only as editorial hard cuts between generated units; never morph, pan or slide between setups inside a unit.

ACTING:
柳如烟 turns red with anger and embarrassment; 季伯达’s hand may briefly enter frame near her hair, but avoid malformed contact.
No character speaks or mouths dialogue in this unit.

TIMELINE:
0.0–0.5s: stable opening hold. 0.5–3.3s: perform the specified silent reaction with restrained motion. 3.3–4.0s: hold a stable final pose for editing.

CAMERA:
Locked or extremely slow push-in of no more than 2%. No reframe, shake, zoom pumping, axis change or background morph.

POST-PRODUCTION:
Wan output must be silent. Exact Mandarin dialogue is generated separately with controlled TTS and optional lip sync. Preserve the final 0.5 seconds as a clean edit handle and continuity reference for the following unit.
